extracted.intended_audience: FERC licensees, regulatory practitioners, attorneys, and legal researchers using the Federal Register
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural standards for publishing and recognizing a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission notice of withdrawal of an application for amendment of license (including required metadata and the conditions under which a withdrawal becomes effective under Commission rules). Also includes guidance about using FederalRegister.gov vs. the official PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal effectiveness under Rule 216(b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to Rule 216(b) of the Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure, the withdrawal of the application became effective on March 12, 2024, and this proceeding is hereby terminated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effectiveness occurs when no motion in opposition has been filed and the Commission takes no action to disallow the withdrawal. See 18 CFR 385.216(b) (2023) for the governing rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: No opposition/motion prerequisite for withdrawal to be effective
rubrics_metrics.description: No motion in opposition to the notice of withdrawal has been filed, and the Commission has taken no action to disallow the withdrawal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A withdrawal will become effective under Rule 216(b) if there is no opposition and no Commission action to disallow; the notice should state whether any opposition was filed and the Commission's response (if any).

rubrics_metrics.name: Include standard document metadata in Federal Register headings
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings may contain the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Document Drafting Handbook for details on required and recommended heading elements when preparing Federal Register notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Link to and rely on official PDF (govinfo.gov) for legal effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Each document posted on this site includes a link to the corresponding official PDF file on govinfo.gov. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FederalRegister.gov is a prototype XML rendition and is not an official legal edition until the ACFR grants it official status; those relying on documents for legal research should verify against the official edition on govinfo.gov because only official editions provide legal notice and judicial notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.

rubrics_metrics.name: XML rendition is informational only; verify against official edition
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype of a 'Web 2.0' version of the daily Federal Register. It is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register, and does not replace the official print version or the official electronic version on GPO’s govinfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While every effort has been made to ensure accurate display, verify results against an official edition for legal research; until ACFR grants official status, the XML rendition does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public inspection listings must be verified against final edition
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are using public inspection listings for legal research, you should verify the contents of the documents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The PDF identified as 'FR Doc. ... as it appeared on Public Inspection' is provided for reference, but users must confirm against the final official edition for legal reliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of contents on FederalRegister.gov is navigational only
rubrics_metrics.description: This table of contents is a navigational tool, processed from the headings within the legal text of Federal Register documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This repetition of headings to form internal navigation links has no substantive legal effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Register document metadata fields present and published
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal Register notices include metadata such as Agencies, Agency/Docket Number, Document Citation, Document Number, Document Type, Page, and Publication Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure these fields are present and accurate in the published notice; the page provides the example values (e.g., Project No., Document Citation 89 FR 19822, Document Number, Publication Date).
